d: We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Credit Analyst to join our team in Manama, Bahrain. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in finance, with a minimum of 2 years of experience in credit analysis or related fields. The Credit Analyst will be responsible for evaluating credit data and financial statements of clients to determine the risk involved in extending credit or lending money.
q: Minimum of 2 years of experience in credit analysis or a related field.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel and other financial analysis tools.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
r: Analyze credit data and financial statements to determine the creditworthiness of individuals or businesses.
Prepare reports that outline the credit analysis findings and present recommendations to management.
Monitor existing clients' credit limits and assess the need for adjustments based on changing financial conditions.
Collaborate with the sales team to provide insights on credit policies and procedures.
Conduct regular reviews of credit portfolios to identify potential risks and opportunities.
Stay updated on economic trends and market conditions that may affect credit risk.
Maintain accurate records of credit analysis and client interactions in compliance with company policies.

d: ADASI is the regional leader in autonomous systems and services, dedicated to offering holistic solutions – from the development and production of unmanned systems to joint mission analysis and equipment acquisition. We manufacture, operate, and maintain next-generation autonomous capabilities for air, land, and sea, operating in demanding environments. Headquartered in the UAE, we are committed to advancing the region’s technological edge in defense innovation.

The Airframe Systems Project Manager will lead all project activities in project management perspective; responsible for budgeting, planning, execution, monitoring & controlling, change & risk management, reporting and delivery of projects in collaboration with all stakeholders focused on airframe systems as hydraulics, actuation systems, landing gear, fuel systems and environmental control system. Acting as the bridge between engineering, procurement, manufacturing, and program management, this role ensures compliance with aerospace standards while driving successful delivery within scope, schedule, and budget.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field; Master’s preferred.
8–12 years of experience in aerospace/defense project management, with direct exposure to airframe systems.
Proven track record in budget management, scheduling tools (MS Project/Primavera), and risk management.
Excellent communication skills for executive and technical audiences.
MS Project or Primavera for scheduling and resource planning.
ERP systems (SAP or equivalent) for project tracking and reporting.
Risk management platforms for monitoring and mitigation.
Collaboration tools (SharePoint, Teams, or equivalent) for stakeholder communication.
r: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables for airframe systems.
Develop and manage detailed project schedules, budgets, and risk registers.
Lead cross-functional teams including design, procurement, finance, legal, production, quality and ILS departments.
Monitor the project from initiation up to delivery by day-to-day coordination with all the stakeholders.
Ensure compliance with FAA/EASA certification requirements and defense standards (e.g., MIL-STD).
Support design reviews, testing campaigns, and production readiness.
Act as primary liaison between engineering teams, suppliers, and executive leadership.
Develop, issue and manage RFIs, RFPs and contractual agreements with airframe subsystem suppliers.
Monitor supplier performance, risks, and deliverables.
Report / present project status to Senior Management and Client.
Manage customer expectations and contractual obligations.
Apply project management methodologies (PMI, Agile, Earned Value Management).
Drive continuous improvement in project execution and reporting.
Ensure adherence to safety, quality and regulatory standards.

d: Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

The Sales Assistant is crucial in generating sales and ensuring a positive customer experience at the store. This role involves maintaining high standards of store cleanliness and presentation, greeting customers warmly, and providing detailed product information. The Sales Assistant is expected to deliver quality service in fitting rooms and manage the cash wrap efficiently. Success in this role is measured by customer satisfaction, cleanliness standards, and sales generation. The position is key to supporting the store management team in operational duties.
q: Ability to work independently and efficiently
What Qualifies You For The Role
Ability to perform heavy lifting and stand for a minimum of 8 hours

r: Maintain store standards and cleanliness to create a sparkling clean and organized environment.
Adhere to dress code and greet customers with an energetic attitude to create a positive first impression.
Provide immediate, sincere greetings to customers entering the store.
Deliver quality service in fitting rooms and maintain cash wrap cleanliness while attempting add-on sales.
Provide current and relevant information about the products to customers.
Efficiently manage cash wrap operations, offer gift cards, capture customer information in the database.
Thank all customers sincerely as they exit the store and invite them back.
